rca of the issue: Bug persists identically from iteration_39. In Matched Set mode the third set-qty tier (300) is only being written into the active component's (Header) qtys[2] array. Display Base and 60ct. Tray still have qtys=[100,150] (length 2). RightDashboard.buildItems iterates per-component qtys[] rather than the top-level setQtys, so for slot index 2 only Header produces a row. This causes (a) Per-Item Qty 300 panel to show only Header, and (b) Per-Job scenario 2 to have non-uniform qtys (150/150/300), which fails the all-qtys-equal check used to emit 'Qty N' and falls back to the 'Scenario N' label. The fix described in the spec (RightDashboard.jsx buildItems L156: isMatched broadcast of top-level set qtys × pcs/set to all components) is NOT in effect in the current served bundle.
